description:
Port-map §6. Non-interactive single-shot:

Flow:
1. Parse --print/-p flag + prompt string from argv (.9 does full
   parsing; .7 just exercises the function)
2. Register core tools (read/write/edit/ls/bash/grep/find)
3. Start session via OctoPi.Agent.start_session with cwd + model
4. Subscribe to events; render MessageUpdate text deltas to stdout,
   tool calls with a prefixed marker, AgentEnd flush
5. Wait for idle; exit code 0 on :stop, non-zero on :error/:aborted

Module: OctoPi.Coder.Modes.Print. Function `run(opts)` takes
%{prompt, cwd, model, tools, session_store?, text_output: bool}.

TDD:
- End-to-end with FakeTransport: prompt → script → stdout contains
  expected text
- Tool call produces `[tool_use: name]` markers in stdout
- :error stop → non-zero exit code
- Session file is written (integration-lite: stub store or real?)

Depends on .2, .4, .5, .6.
title: Print mode: argv → prompt → event stream → stdout
